cards.front: La música podría haber estado un poco más alta.
cards.back: The music could have been a bit louder.

cards.front: Podríamos haberlo hecho un poco más obvio.
cards.back: We could have made it a bit more obvious.

cards.front: Podría haber sido un desastre.
cards.back: It could have been a disaster.

cards.front: ¡Habérmelo dicho antes!
cards.back: You could have told me before!

cards.front: ¡Haberme dicho que pensabas irte!
cards.back: You could have told me you were thinking of leaving!

cards.front: ¡Habernos dicho que habían cancelado el pedido!
cards.back: You could have told us they'd cancelled the order!

cards.front: Hubiera jurado que te vi en la conferencia la semana pasada.
cards.back: I could have sworn I saw you at the conference last week.

cards.front: Hubiese jurado que ella me dijo que hablaba alemán.
cards.back: I could have sworn she told me she spoke German.

cards.front: Hubiera jurado que dijiste que naciste en Puerto Rico.
cards.back: I could have sworn you said you were born in Puerto Rico.

cards.front: Por lo visto, se dejó el informe sin querer en el autobús. ¡Le hubiera matado!
cards.back: Apparently, he accidentally left the report on the bus. I could have killed him!

cards.front: Afortunadamente, Tim había hecho una copia de seguridad. ¡Le hubiera besado!
cards.back: Luckily, Tim had made a back-up copy. I could have kissed him!

cards.front: Todo el mundo quería que me levantara y cantara una canción. ¡Me hubiera muerto!
cards.back: Everybody wanted me to get up and sing a song. I could have died!

cards.front: Me hubiera venido bien tu ayuda anoche.
cards.back: I could have done with your help last night.

cards.front: Nos hubiera venido bien uno de esos cuando nos quedamos atrapados en el barro.
cards.back: We could have done with one of those when we got stuck in the mud.

cards.front: Me hubiera venido bien una buena cerveza fría después de llevar todas esas cajas pesadas.
cards.back: I could have done with a nice cold beer after carrying all those heavy boxes.

cards.front: No habrías podido hacerlo.
cards.back: You couldn't have done it.

cards.front: Harry no habría podido volar en su estado de salud.
cards.back: Harry couldn't have flown in his state of health.

cards.front: No habríamos podido correr con ese tiempo.
cards.back: We couldn't have gone running in that weather.

cards.front: No lo habría podido hacer sin la ayuda de mi profesor.
cards.back: I couldn't have done it without my teacher's help.

cards.front: No habría podido correr la maratón sin haber entrenado duro antes.
cards.back: I couldn't have run the marathon without having trained hard beforehand.

cards.front: No habría podido escribir la novela sin tu apoyo.
cards.back: I couldn't have written the novel without your support.

cards.front: No habría podido hacer todo el trabajo solo.
cards.back: I couldn't have done all the work by myself.

cards.front: No habrían podido terminarlo solos.
cards.back: They couldn't have finished it by themselves.

cards.front: No habrías podido escribir un libro sola en una semana.
cards.back: You couldn't have written a book in one week by yourself.

cards.front: No habría podido limpiar la casa solo.
cards.back: I couldn't have cleaned the house on my own.

cards.front: Él no habría podido escaparse solo.
cards.back: He couldn't have escaped on his own.

cards.front: Ella no habría podido hacerlo sola.
cards.back: She couldn't have done it on her own.

cards.front: Ella no habría podido mover sola un mueble tan pesado.
cards.back: She couldn't have moved such a heavy piece of furniture by herself.

cards.front: No habrían podido construir un edificio tan enorme en sólo un mes.
cards.back: They couldn't have built such a huge building in only a month.

cards.front: No habría podido comer un plato tan grande de marisco yo solo.
cards.back: I couldn't have eaten such a big plate of seafood on my own.

cards.front: Puedo doblar la lengua desde que era niño.
cards.back: I've been able to roll my tongue ever since I was a child.

cards.front: Mi hermana nunca ha podido doblar la lengua.
cards.back: My sister's never been able to roll her tongue.

cards.front: ¿Poder doblar la lengua va a llevarte lejos en la vida?
cards.back: Is being able to roll your tongue going to get you far in life?

cards.front: No todo el mundo puede mover las orejas sin tocarlas.
cards.back: Not everyone can wiggle their ears without touching them.

cards.front: Alguna gente puede mover las orejas sin tocarlas.
cards.back: Some people can wiggle their ears without touching them.

cards.front: ¿La gente que puede mover las orejas sin tocarlas puede hacer reír a los niños?
cards.back: Can people who can wiggle their ears without touching them make children laugh?

cards.front: Si puedes levantar una ceja, ¿en qué situaciones lo haces y qué sentido tiene?
cards.back: If you can raise one eyebrow, when do you do it and what does it denote?

cards.front: ¿Mucha gente que conoces puede levantar una ceja?
cards.back: Can many people you know raise one eyebrow?

cards.front: ¿Qué tenista famoso puede levantar una ceja y a menudo lo hace durante las ruedas de prensa?
cards.back: Which famous tennis player can raise one eyebrow, and often does when giving press conferences?

cards.front: ¿Conoces a alguien que puede tocarse la nariz con la punta de la lengua?
cards.back: Do you know anyone who can touch their nose with the tip of their tongue?

cards.front: Casi nadie puede tocarse la nariz con la punta de la lengua.
cards.back: Hardly anyone can touch the end of their nose with the tip of their tongue.

cards.front: Serás popular en las fiestas si puedes tocarte la nariz con la punta de la lengua.
cards.back: You will be popular at parties if you can touch your nose with the tip of your tongue.

cards.front: ¿Sabías que es posible chuparte tu propio codo?
cards.back: Did you know that it's possible to be able to lick your elbow?

cards.front: Hace falta una lengua larga y un brazo corto para poder chuparte tu propio codo.
cards.back: You need a long tongue and a short upper arm to be able to lick your elbow.

cards.front: La mayoría de la gente nunca podrá chuparse su propio codo.
cards.back: Most people will never be able to lick their own elbow.

cards.front: Puede que llegue tarde.
cards.back: I might be late.

cards.front: Puede que caiga granizo mañana.
cards.back: It might hail tomorrow.

cards.front: Puede que te resulte difícil.
cards.back: You might find it difficult.

cards.front: ¿Crees que el Barcelona ganará la liga? A lo mejor.
cards.back: Do you think Barcelona are going to win the league? They might.

cards.front: ¿Tu primo también va a venir? A lo mejor.
cards.back: Is your cousin going to come as well? He might.

cards.front: ¿Vas a apuntarte a ese curso? A lo mejor.
cards.back: Are you going to sign up for that course? I might.

cards.front: Puede que haya un problema con el sistema.
cards.back: There might be a problem with the system.

cards.front: Puede que haya más gente en el evento de lo que nos esperábamos.
cards.back: There might be more people at the event than we were expecting.

cards.front: Puede que haya tormentas en la zona de Sevilla.
cards.back: There might be storms in the Seville area.

cards.front: Es posible que sea demasiado tarde.
cards.back: It might be too late.

cards.front: Es posible que haya atascos.
cards.back: There might be traffic jams.

cards.front: Es posible que vuelva a ocurrir lo mismo.
cards.back: The same thing might happen again.

cards.front: Igual al final no nos ofrecen el contrato.
cards.back: We might not win the contract after all.

cards.front: Igual al final no lo hago.
cards.back: I might not do it after all.

cards.front: Igual al final no se casan.
cards.back: They might not get married after all.

cards.front: ¿De verdad crees que se puede hacer?
cards.back: Do you really think it's doable?

cards.front: Puede que sea factible, pero no estoy seguro.
cards.back: It might be doable, but I'm not sure.

cards.front: Nada es imposible. Todo se puede hacer.
cards.back: Nothing's impossible. Everything is doable.

cards.front: Sus motivos para querer dejar la empresa son comprensibles.
cards.back: His reasons for wanting to leave the company are understandable.

cards.front: ¿Pensaste que su excusa era muy creíble?
cards.back: Did you think his excuse was very believable?

cards.front: Dije que era concebible que pudiesen ganar la liga, no dije que fuese probable.
cards.back: I said it was conceivable for them to win the league, I didn't say it was likely.

cards.front: Si tienes el dinero, ahora podría ser un buen momento para comprar una casa, ya que los precios son más accesibles.
cards.back: If you have the money, now could be a good time to buy a house as the prices are more affordable.

cards.front: Éstos son servicios que se suelen cobrar.
cards.back: These are typical chargeable services.

cards.front: El alquiler se abona en la primera semana de cada mes.
cards.back: The rent is payable in the first week of every month.

cards.front: ¿Cómo podrías tener problemas con Jenny? Es imposible conocer a alguien más agradable que ella.
cards.back: How could you have problems with Jenny? You couldn't meet anybody more likeable than her.

cards.front: ¡Tus niños son tan adorables!
cards.back: Your children are so lovable!

cards.front: ¡Tienes los labios más apetecibles que he visto nunca!
cards.back: You have the most kissable lips I've ever seen!

cards.front: ¿Cómo puedes trabajar con este calor? Es insoportable.
cards.back: How can you work in this heat? It's unbearable.

cards.front: La velocidad a la que estamos utilizando los recursos naturales del mundo es insostenible.
cards.back: The speed at which we are using the world's natural resources is unsustainable.

cards.front: ¡Ya, claro! También dijeron que el Titanic era insumergible.
cards.back: Yeah, right! And they said the Titanic was unsinkable!

cards.front: Los árboles no te dejan ver el bosque.
cards.back: You can't see the forest for the trees.

cards.front: No ves más allá de tus narices.
cards.back: You can't see beyond the end of your nose.

cards.front: No le encuentro ni pies ni cabeza a tus argumentos.
cards.back: I can't make head or tail of your arguments.

cards.front: Loro viejo no aprende a hablar.
cards.back: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.

cards.front: Aunque la mona se vista de seda, mona se queda.
cards.back: A leopard can't change his spots.

cards.front: Puedes darle un consejo a alguien, pero no puedes obligarlo a que lo siga.
cards.back: You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink.

cards.front: Sal de la cocina si no aguantas el calor.
cards.back: If you can't take the heat, get out of the kitchen.

cards.front: Me temo que no dieron la talla.
cards.back: I'm afraid they just couldn't cut the mustard.

cards.front: Como cantante él no daba la talla.
cards.back: He couldn't cut it as a singer.

cards.front: No se hace una tortilla sin romper los huevos.
cards.back: You can't make an omelet without breaking the eggs.

cards.front: No puedes tenerlo todo.
cards.back: You can't have your cake and eat it too.

cards.front: No puedes tener ambas cosas a la vez.
cards.back: You can't have it both ways.

cards.front: Las apariencias engañan.
cards.back: You can't judge a book by its cover.

cards.front: No le llega a Elvis ni a la suela de sus zapatos.
cards.back: He can't hold a candle to Elvis.

cards.front: Él tiene algo, no sabría decir concretamente qué es.
cards.back: There's something about him, I can't quite put my finger on it.
